load_emotion_classifier: load an Expresso emotion classification model from a checkpoint path for audio emotion prediction
predict_audio: predict the emotion label and logits for an audio file using the loaded emotion classifier
wav2emotion: classify a WAV audio file or array into a single predicted emotion label
wav2emotion_and_sentiment: classify a WAV audio file into both an emotion label and its mapped sentiment
expresso_emotion2_sentiment: map an Expresso emotion label like happy or angry to a sentiment like positive or negative
